metadata.question: Did Phoenix experienced a record 40 consecutive days in which the land surface temperature exceeded 110 degrees Fahrenheit in the summer of 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Phoenix, Arizona (approximately 33.45°N, -112.07°W) - Date: Summer 2023 (June-August, but need to find consecutive days) - Collection: MODIS LST data (MOD11A1 or MYD11A1) which provides daily land surface temperature - Need to check for 40 consecutive days with LST > 110°F (43.33°C) 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QC bands that should be used to mask poor quality data - Need to ensure we're getting valid temperature readings - Should check both day and night temperatures, but "land surface temperature exceeded 110°F" likely refers to daytime maximum 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - C1: If no images found for summer 2023 - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked due to QC - C3: If calculation fails or temperature values are unrealistic - A: If 40+ consecutive days with max LST > 110°F found - B: If fewer than 40 consecutive days found ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Phoenix area const phoenix = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.07, 33.45]); const region = phoenix.buffer(10000); // 10km radius // Summer 2023 period (June-September to capture potential streak) const startDate = '2023-06-01'; const endDate = '2023-09-30'; // Get MODIS Terra LST daily data let col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterBounds(phoenix) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); const colSize = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No images found for summer 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Convert collection to list and process each day const colList = col.toList(colSize); const dates = []; const temps = []; for (let i = 0; i < colSize; i++) { const img = ee.Image(colList.get(i)); const date = img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); // Get LST value (in Kelvin * 0.02 scale factor) const lstValue = img.select('LST_Day_1km').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); if (lstValue !== null) { // Convert from Kelvin to Fahrenheit: K * 0.02 to get K, then (K - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32 const tempK = lstValue * 0.02; const tempF = (tempK - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32; dates.push(date); temps.push(tempF); } } console.log(`Valid temperature readings: ${temps.length}`); if (temps.length === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Find longest consecutive streak above 110°F let maxStreak = 0; let currentStreak = 0; let streakStart = null; for (let i = 0; i < temps.length; i++) { if (temps[i] > 110) { if (currentStreak === 0) { streakStart = dates[i]; } currentStreak++; if (currentStreak > maxStreak) { maxStreak = currentStreak; } } else { currentStreak = 0; } } console.log(`Longest consecutive streak: ${maxStreak} days`); console.log(`Days above 110°F: ${temps.filter(t => t > 110).length}/${temps.length}`); console.log(`Max temp: ${Math.max(...temps).toFixed(1)}°F`); console.log(`Min temp: ${Math.min(...temps).toFixed(1)}°F`); // Check for unrealistic values if (Math.max(...temps) > 160 || Math.min(...temps) < 0) { console.log('Unrealistic temperature values detected'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (maxStreak >= 40) { console.log(`Found ${maxStreak} consecutive days exceeding 110°F`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Only ${maxStreak} consecutive days found, less than 40`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
